english: the eve of a decisive battle, the night before a showdown

english: to obtain, to get hold of, to acquire

english: one's own reasons, convenience, circumstances

barely, just barely, right at the limit
notes: text: ギリギリ合格といっていいだろう — you could call it a bare pass

english: alliance
notes: text: 同盟組もうぜ — let's form an alliance

english: each other, one another, mutually
rather, if anything, on the contrary
as long as, provided that (used as 〜ない限り, "unless")

english: to search for, to look for

notes: text: なんでヒソカは反撃しないんだ — why isn't Hisoka fighting back?

one's final moment, the end (esp. of life), one's death

english: spirit, morale, fighting resolve
a fatal wound, a mortal injury
notes: text: すでに誰かから致命傷を負わされてんだろ — you've already been dealt a fatal wound by someone, haven't you

english: to cling to someone in tears, to beg tearfully
notes: text: 泣きつかれたんだろ — he came crying to you, right?

english: to let live, to spare (someone's life), to make use of

english: to aim at, to target

this time for sure, this time without fail

english: to find, to discover, to spot
notes: text: 見〜〜つけた — found you~

english: settlement, conclusion, resolution (of a conflict)
